loss_binding.sign: u=-Punch RP U2, F=-Punch RP RF2; experimental signs unchanged

metrics: maximum PEEQ and actual table coverage
direct ALLPD and reference/current IP-volume distributions
cumulative-region vs increment-by-strain energy with thresholds actual p_switch,.1,.3,.5
contact footprint/CPRESS/COPEN sentinel treatment,1.10–1.16mm raw accepted frame review
cutback,accepted/rejected warnings,solve wall-clock and allocated CPU cost
causal_scope: only high-p material changes; significant response implies sensitivity to this continuation, not unique cause of experimental error
numerical_vs_sensitivity: old refinement small-difference PASS thresholds are NOT acceptance thresholds on intentional material response changes

descriptive_effect_flags.use: predeclared engineering effect flags, not statistical significance, physical accuracy, guaranteed numerical error bound or new model numerical PASS

eligibility: Datacheck and Full actual complete identities and readable safe ODB
no unexplained accepted-state strain/contact instability or substantial force recoil
local response changes must be compared with warnings,energy and contact history; outcome may remain inconclusive without further numerical qualification
failure_rule: keep failed/unknown/unscoreable Loss=null,started attempt consumed,no auto retry or extra candidate
if_both_low_sensitivity: only this +/-50% tangent and switch/width is screened; prioritize measured fixture-boundary uncertainty before more same-model parameter valley points, then orthogonal identification if justified
physical_bounds: no claim that engineered upper/lower rates are confidence bounds
